concepts.name: battle
concepts.definition: A contest between two sides whose seats, actions, and derived state are recorded through a command log.

concepts.name: roster
concepts.definition: A named selection of units and loadouts that is priced against a verified catalogue and may be saved or frozen for play.

concepts.name: catalogue
concepts.definition: The verified snapshot of fetched community game data used to present and evaluate selectable rules and units.

concepts.name: faction
concepts.definition: A catalogue-defined army grouping from which a roster selects its units and detachment.

concepts.name: detachment
concepts.definition: A catalogue-defined choice within a faction that governs roster options and enhancements.

concepts.name: mission
concepts.definition: A source-defined objective and scoring rule used during a battle.

concepts.name: league
concepts.definition: An organized play container whose events register entrants and reveal sealed rosters.

concepts.name: league event
concepts.definition: A registration cycle within a league that collects entrants, seals rosters, and reveals them together.

concepts.name: account
concepts.definition: A user identity required to save a roster, occupy a battle seat, or enter a league.

concepts.name: friend
concepts.definition: A mutual relationship between accounts that permits shared battles to be opened.

concepts.name: warlord
concepts.definition: A selected catalogue-eligible Character or Epic Hero whose count is checked per roster or doubles team at league sealing.

concepts.name: secret mission
concepts.definition: A mission whose choice or progress is hidden from other sides until its reveal rule permits disclosure.

concepts.name: practice opponent
concepts.definition: An account with no credentials that occupies a battle seat as an automated opponent.

concepts.name: watchable
concepts.definition: Permitted for a reader to observe under the narrowest audience setting of all battle seats.

concepts.name: contract
concepts.definition: A serializable TypeScript shape shared across browser and server boundaries.
